record_template.candidate: <a candidate id on this page, or null>
record_template.what: <what the exhibit is, in your words: its form and what it is made of>
record_template.message: <the one thing a reader takes from it>
record_template.how_drawn: <how the reference draws it: what is compared against what, order, colour, labels, legend, gridlines, number formats>
record_template.marks: <what the reference marks on it and how (a ring, a band, a line, a callout, a bold row, a colour), where the claim lives, and whether words beside the mark say what it marks; or that it marks nothing and how the claim still reads>
record_template.chart_or_table: <true when it is a chart or a table, drawn natively or pasted as a picture: the pages the source-line habit is counted over>
record_template.axis_labels: <true when it sets axis or category labels>
record_template.value_labels: <true when it sets values on its marks>

source_line: on every page holding a chart or a table: true or false, read off the page; null elsewhere

exhibits.what: pasted horizontal bar chart picture of people using each substance in the past month
exhibits.message: alcohol dwarfs every other substance, and illicit drugs other than marijuana are small
exhibits.how_drawn: bars sorted within two groups, light blue for nicotine or alcohol and teal for illicit drugs, legend above, values in millions at the bar ends, value axis below with a bold title, no gridlines
exhibits.marks: nothing ringed; colour separates the two substance groups named in the legend

exhibits.what: pasted pie of users against non users with a boxed breakout bar chart of products joined by leader lines
exhibits.message: about a fifth of people used nicotine, mostly cigarettes and vaping
exhibits.how_drawn: grey remainder slice and teal user slice labelled in bold words with millions and percent; breakout bars teal for tobacco and light blue for vaping with values at bar ends, legend above, box outline round the breakout
exhibits.marks: the user slice is exploded into the breakout via two leader lines; nothing else marked

exhibits.what: pasted 100 percent stacked column chart picture of product type mix by age group
exhibits.message: young people mostly vape only, older adults mostly use tobacco only
exhibits.how_drawn: blue, green and yellow segments with values centred inside at one decimal, stacked legend above, value axis 0 to 100 titled along the left, total category set apart by a gap and bold label
exhibits.marks: the total column is set apart with extra space and a bold label; no ring

exhibits.what: pasted line chart picture with markers, one line per age group across survey years, nicotine product use 2022 to 2025
exhibits.message: how each age group's rate moved over the survey years and whether the change was significant
exhibits.how_drawn: four series in navy triangles, blue circles, green squares and maroon pentagons; total population line bold navy; value axis titled turned along the left, no gridlines, light grey panel ground; legend at right headed 'Age Group' in grey with a trend icon after each entry
exhibits.marks: nothing ringed; the trend icon beside each legend entry (black circle with arrow, or hollow minus) carries the significance claim, and the total's legend entry is bold

exhibits.what: native table of the plotted estimates with a grey header row and a Trend column of icons and words
exhibits.message: the exact percentages behind every point and the trend verdict per group
exhibits.how_drawn: grey 767171 header with white bold labels, white body rows without rules, a grey rule under the last row, the total row bold, numbers centred at one decimal, an icon picture laid over each trend cell beside the word
exhibits.marks: the total row set bold and the Decreased or Increased words bold while No Change stays regular, so significant changes stand out
